name: When should I consider renovating my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider renovating my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider renovating your bathroom if fixtures are outdated or damaged, if you have persistent plumbing issues like leaks or low water pressure, or if the layout no longer meets your needs. A renovation can also increase your home's value, improve energy efficiency, or address accessibility concerns. If your bathroom feels uninviting or lacks functionality, it might be time for an upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovate when fixtures are outdated, plumbing issues arise, layout is inefficient, or to increase home value and improve functionality.
